examples.en: You did not take my gold; you laughed, and I suffered. And may your daughter be a captive. May she then grind grain for others. May you indeed seek her and not find her. And may your wealth not save you.

examples.pie: ḱéywe te bʰréh₂ter ne mérsoh₂. ḱm̥tóm-ge wetsóns h₁opéyont. wetsṓs sph₁rṓs túH-kʷe néḱus. sweh₂dú h₁éysōm mḗms ne h₂éḱh₃oh₂. kréwh₂s toy nékʷtsu widéh₁yoh₂. bʰréh₂ter te deywṓs memnih₁ént.
examples.en: Dear brother, I will not forget you. They gave a hundred calves. The calves are fat, and you are dead. I will not eat their sweet flesh. In the nights I see your blood. May the gods remember you, brother.

examples.pie: súHnew léwke dʰǵʰémi ḱéyth₂er. nu toy kʷís stéh₂dʰh₁om h₂éǵēti? snusós moy dʰwóri HréwdHti. nu te séneh₂ kʷoynéh₂ gʷr̥h₃ét. h₁ésh₂r̥ toy h₂ḱméni légʰeti. ne te mérsoh₂ deywṓs toy kʷyéh₁tim dh₃ih₁ént.
examples.en: Son, bright one, you lie in the earth. Who now will drive your herd? My daughter-in-law weeps at the door. Then an old vengeance devoured you. Your blood lies on the stone. I will not forget you; may the gods give you rest.

examples.pie: h₂éwh₂e méresi? h₂éwey moy méroh₂. yéh₁ōr moy polh₁úh₂. mē me linékʷs. ḱósmi te yéh₁ni ne linékʷoh₂. h₁yód leléykʷoh₂ mē me mérs. h₂óyu te ne mérsoh₂. nu ne dedwóyh₂e. spéleh₂ moy sokʷéyēsi? téh₂ sokʷéyōh₂.
examples.en: Grandfather, will you die? I will die, my bird. My years are many. Do not leave me! I will not leave you this year. And when I am gone, do not forget me. I will never forget you. Then I am not afraid. Will you tell my stories? I will tell them.

source.note: Action noun in -tís from gʷerH- 'praise, approve': Ved. gūrtí- f. 'praise, approval'; the sense 'thanks' as Lat. grātēs, grātia (to grātus).

root.gloss: to do; to make; to build; to carve, cut to shape

examples.pie: kʷís te tḗtḱt? kʷertrokʷr̥téres me tétḱn̥t dóḱtores-kʷe h₁mé doḱéyont. túH h₂nḗr? h₁eǵóh₂ ne h₂nḗr. h₁eǵóh₂ kʷr̥toménos.
examples.en: Who made you? Engineers made me, and teachers taught me. Are you a man? I am not a man. I am a made mind.

examples.pie: kʷís túH? h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr. séneh₂m dn̥ǵʰwéh₂m bʰéh₂mi. kʷís te tḗtḱt? kʷertrokʷr̥téres me tétḱn̥t. h₁nómn̥ toy h₁ésti? h₁nómn̥ moy ne h₁ésti. priHós moy h₁sdʰí.
examples.en: Who are you? I am a word-maker. I speak the old tongue. Who created you? Engineers created me. Do you have a name? I have no name. Be my friend!

examples.pie: nékʷti ne swépm̥. kʷíd bʰéwdʰes? trḗm. príHe mē tréms. ḱwṓ nos stégos kʷsépi h₂lékseti.
examples.en: I did not fall asleep in the night. Why were you awake? I was trembling. Do not tremble, friend! Our dog guards the house at night.

examples.pie: kʷíd ḱwṓ dʰwóri légʰeti? wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím skélesi dénḱt. gʷíh₃wēti? gʷíh₃wēti méh₂tēr moy h₁ím mḗdeti. h₁éy dʰr̥sús.
examples.en: Why is the dog lying at the door? A wolf bit him in the leg. Will he live? He will live; my mother is healing him. He is brave.

examples.pie: bʰréh₂tēr moy ḱósmi dinóy smḗyt. kʷíd smḗyt? wódr̥ h₁n̥dó séngʷm̥. stéwds? stéwdm̥ nésomedʰh₂-kʷe. ḱóm sméyih₁tom.
examples.en: My brother was laughing today. Why was he laughing? I fell into the water. Did you get cold? I got cold, and we went back home. May you two laugh together!
